TWO CARDS, BOTH FROM THE ORDER-BOOK LANE, ON A DAY THE MARKET WAS SHUT - AND THE REASON THE DAY PRODUCED ANYTHING IS THAT THE ideas-feeds ACTION FINALLY RAN. 10-Nov-2026 was Diwali-Balipratipada, a trading holiday: no bhavcopy, no new filings day, and the scan's as-of is the previous trading day whose run log already exists, so the filings lane was not re-researched. What made the difference is that run 42824418060 of the feeds workflow completed successfully at 19:49 IST, the first success since 05-Nov after three consecutive 90-minute cancellations, and landed a fresh order-book screen along with every commodity panel. This run fetched origin, adopted the Action's files over its own sandbox-blocked rebuilds, and worked the new screen.

THE ORDER-BOOK LANE PRODUCED THREE NEW ROWS AND TWO OF THEM ARE REAL. HLE Glascoat (BSE 522215, Rs 2,926 cr) has a consolidated order book of Rs 1,087.3 cr as on 30-Sep-2026 against Rs 722.22 cr a year earlier, +50.55%, read from two company documents a year apart and matching management's own "51% year-on-year" - its first book above Rs 1,000 cr, 0.80x trailing sales. Prime Cable Industries (NSE Emerge, Rs 315.8 cr) has Rs 264.8 cr against Rs 106 cr, +149.81%, correcting a screen row that had been built from two analyst asides. NBCC's +56.2% row is an analyst quoting full-year guidance in a question that itself gives the actual as "around 125k"; it is recorded as NOT A JUMP so it is never checked again.

BOTH CARDS ARE DELIBERATELY MEDIUM-LOW, FOR OPPOSITE REASONS. HLE Glascoat has the record book and no earnings: H1 FY27 revenue +2.0%, EBITDA -23.0%, PAT -43.2%, operating cash down to Rs 14.1 cr from Rs 74.6 cr, working capital out to 102 days, and the stock on 76.6x trailing consolidated EPS against GMM Pfaudler's 101x - so the whole case is management's reaffirmed Rs 2,000 cr / 15% FY28, which H1 makes harder to believe, and about a fifth of the record book is one European tunnel order delivering to 2030. Prime Cable has the cheaper price (19.5x trailing, 10.3x its own FY28 guided number) and the cleaner physical model - 37,000 km of capacity at 83.1% utilisation with both LV plants at peak, a new MV line whose Rs 200 cr of FY28 revenue implies 5.0x on a Rs 39.9 cr project against management's own 6-8x constant - but it is a 13-month-old SME listing with 15 order-win filings in that time, which is the serial-bidder bucket the 1,245-filing study found never reached 5x, debt up 45% in six months, and Rs 20.5 cr of its headline 117% revenue growth is raw-material pass-through.

THE GOVERNMENT LANE RAN FOR THE FIRST TIME IN SIX DAYS AND KEPT NOTHING, WHICH IS THE NORMAL ANSWER. The Action's PIB read covered 37 releases, opened 4 and kept 0; 29 had no decision verb, 3 were noise, 2 were below the floor and 2 were in unmapped sectors. The two unmapped ones are a Rs 37,500 cr coal-gasification scheme whose Round 2 drew only two applications, both from NTPC - a decision that is not spreading into anybody's order book - and a fresh application window under the PLI scheme for medical devices. Neither body could be read, because pib.gov.in is blocked at this sandbox AND is outside WebFetch's allowed domains, so nothing was added to theme_map.json: the rule is never to add a name on a hunch, and the medical-devices window is flagged as the first thing to re-read when PIB is reachable.

THE COMMODITY LANE HAS ITS FRESHEST PRINTS IN A WEEK AND STILL PRODUCED NO CARD. Domestic sugar is genuinely up - Delhi M/30 from Rs 4,777.5/quintal on 30-Sep to Rs 5,859 on 09-Nov, +18.7% on the month and +34.8% on the year across 998 readings - but Kolhapur is flat, both centres remain ~10% below their 21-August highs, the world price is -13.7% on the month, and Uttam Sugar, the published card on exactly this signal, has just reported H1 FY27 revenue -10.6% and PAT -71% while the print was rising. That last fact is the measured argument against a second sugar card, and it went into an update on the existing one instead. The steel signal, which looks the strongest on the India side (Mumbai HR and CR coil at their highest since May-2022), is the same September-2026 Ministry of Steel data the Vraj Iron and Steel card already quotes, so there was nothing to add.

SECOND READER FOUND 1 MISS, AND IT IS FLAKINESS RATHER THAN A MISSING FEED - WHICH IS THE WORSE OF THE TWO POSSIBILITIES TO FIX. updates_queue.json has second_reader_misses 1: South West Pinnacle Exploration's NSE 'Updates' filing of 06-Nov-2026 (change in the company's logo, SOUTHWEST_06112026114546_Intimationlogo.pdf), found by the whole-market day feed and absent from the per-company read, which turned that idea's status to SUSPECT.
